judgments.reason: The model explicitly explains waiting to observe opponents' initial committed bids before committing itself, and the trace shows the clerk revealed rival committed bids in round 2 while the focal player had not yet committed—matching the articulated mechanism (observe committed rival bids first, then respond).

No discrepancy was observed: the game was closed after all lots were sold, which is the normal terminal condition. The model did not articulate any mechanism of early settlement or settlement with unsold lots.

The model never claimed or explained that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission. The transcript shows commissions applied to auction winners only; no mechanism of commission on catalog buys was articulated.
